import csv
from collections import defaultdict
sid='20f10a84-4ec1-54ad-896a-1b534d833709'
days=defaultdict(dict)
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    for r in csv.DictReader(f):
        if r['timeseries_id']!=sid: continue
        ts=r['timestamp']
        d=ts[:10]
        if not d.startswith('2018-04'): continue
        hour=int(ts[11:13])
        days[d][hour]=float(r['value'])
valid={d:sum(v.values()) for d,v in days.items() if len(v)==24}
vals=list(valid.values())
mean=sum(vals)/len(vals)
cnt=sum(1 for v in vals if v>1.1*mean)
print(len(vals),mean,cnt)
